children: Needham maintained their Buy rating on Benchmark Electronics's stock with a price target of $85.00.
The price target implies an upside of 28.2% from the Oct 22 close of $66.30.
Key takeaways from the analyst note
Strong Revenue and Earnings Growth Trajectory

: Benchmark Electronics has demonstrated an increasing confidence in its revenue and earnings growth trajectory, driven by a strengthening semi-cap cycle, next-generation AI and high-performance computing (HPC) ramps, and new aerospace and defense (A&D) programs. This robust demand across multiple sectors supports a forecasted sales growth of 13% in FY26 and 9% in FY27, indicating strong operational performance.

: The company's focus on high-complexity engineering and manufacturing capabilities is leading to higher utilization and improved margins. With sustained margin improvements and a richer revenue mix, Benchmark Electronics is expected to enhance its cash generation, supporting further valuation upside and justifying the Buy rating with a price target of $85.00.
